entities.summary: Szydłowiec is a town in Szydłowiec County, Mazovian Voivodeship, south-central Poland, with 11,837 inhabitants. It is the seat of Gmina Szydłowiec (commune). Szydłowiec is part of the historic region of Lesser Poland.
